class.name: CommunicationSpeechBox2D
class.description: CommunicationSpeechBox2D (`Control`) Runtime 2D speech-box presenter replacing `old_gdscript_plugins/ideam_dialogue/scripts/dialogue_box.gd`. Driven by `Spline1DResource` reveal curves, `Spline2DResource` prosody font modulation, and `GameplayAccessibilityOption` closed-caption scaling. Part of IdeamCommunications (in-game messaging, channels, and dialogue routing).
